resources.string: 🔌 RONIN R9 MODE: Keep the handsfree PLUGGED IN. Tap 🔌 HANDSFREE (RONIN R9) → START. Input = headset mic (what you talk into), Output = PHONE SPEAKER at max volume — so your voice is amplified, echoed and doubled out of the phone speaker, the Ronin mic hears it and WePlay doubles it again. Talk normally, keep the phone 1 ft away, speaker facing you. If the room is quiet, check that the phone speaker (not the earbud) is playing.
